exposure: Delivery within 7 days of betamethasone dosing
Delivery within 14 days of betamethasone dosing
cohort: 209 women, gestational ages 23-34 weeks, who received betamethasone for threatened preterm birth
finding: In women receiving betamethasone for threatened preterm birth, only cesarean delivery was associated with increased odds of neonatal RDS.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth was associated with increased odds of neonatal RDS after antenatal betamethasone use.
